basics.name: Rob O'Dwyer
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer: Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, and Automation
basics.summary: Software engineer with 15+ years of experience spanning startup CTO, Principal Engineer at Workday, and independent infrastructure consulting. Specialized in large, complex cloud migration projects. Highly experienced in platform infrastructure and DevOps, with a focus on solving complex problems that drive core app requirements including performance, reliability, and migrations.

work.name: Whalesync
work.summary: Owned product and infrastructure projects end to end for a real-time data sync platform, using AI assisted development to migrate integrations used by hundreds of customers successfully.
highlights: Migrated sync integrations to new infra using an AI-assisted harness with automated validation of production data.
Researched and developed features powered by generative AI to streamline the experience of setting up a Whalesync sync.

work.summary: Led cloud-based infrastructure migrations for three startups:
highlights: Whalesync: Migrated production and staging infrastructure from AWS to GCP with no data loss or disruption to customer's sync operations.
WATS: Built an automated deploy pipeline on AWS.
OtherSphere: Built automated deploy pipelines and observability tooling.

work.name: DevCycle
work.summary: Implemented SDKs in multiple languages, built new features for the DevCycle feature flag platform, and maintained DevCycle and Taplytics infrastructure.
highlights: Partnered with a flagship customer to optimize the Go SDK for their low-latency use case, and succeeded in achieving the goal of sub-50-nanosecond 90th percentile lookups across their production fleet.
Built automated release pipelines on GitHub Actions for Go, Python, JavaScript, and Java SDKs to maximize platform compatibility.
Supported the team's successful SOC 2 audit by documenting architecture, fixing security gaps, and running gameday exercises with the developer team.

work.name: Battlesnake
work.summary: Developed and scaled the Battlesnake game engine server and global proxy system.
highlights: Built out a global multi-datacenter proxy system to calculate player latency more equitably.
Engaged with a worldwide developer community of thousands through open source contributions and community discussions.

work.name: Workday
work.summary: Developed cloud services for processing video and interactive learning content.
highlights: Led the zero-downtime migration of a highly sensitive production service along with customer data from the Workday datacenter to AWS.
Interviewed, trained, and mentored a 3-person developer team in Dublin, Ireland. Established a satellite team to provide support EU-based partner teams and implement follow-the-sun support practices

work.name: Pretio Interactive
work.summary: Technical co-founder, responsible for developing Pretio's core technology and growing the development team. Pretio Interactive was an ad-tech startup that combined machine learning and consumer preferences to serve personalized ads.
highlights: Recruited and trained development team while building the technology platform for Pretio's advertising network.
Designed and built a high throughput HTTP server in Go for integrating into real-time bidding networks, and successfully scaled it to operate at 10K requests/second.
Researched and implemented online machine learning techniques to optimize profitability.

work.name: Entrepreneurship@Alacrity
work.summary: The Entrepreneurship@Alacrity program provided an intense training environment to prepare graduates for entrepreneurship in the technology sector.
